overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures premium spray dried chicory powder for commercial food and beverage processing. Sourced from selected chicory roots in India, our fine powder delivers consistent solubility and smooth dispersibility. Our specialized spray drying process removes moisture rapidly while preserving the natural properties of the raw material. It offers an effective base for diverse industrial formulations.

As an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter, we maintain rigorous production standards across our 6-step process. Each production batch undergoes thorough inspection, cleaning, controlled drying, grinding, and packing. We offer dependable bulk supply alongside custom mesh and packaging solutions. We provide complete export documentation support to ensure smooth international procurement for manufacturers and distributors.
highlights: Fine particle consistency with 80-100 mesh size
Produced using advanced spray drying processing
High solubility for seamless liquid dispersion
Standard minimum order quantity of 5 Kg
applications: Dry mix and powder drink formulations

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
faqs.a: The minimum order quantity is 5 Kg for standard orders, with bulk supply volumes available.

faqs.q: What packaging options do you supply?
faqs.a: We provide 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5 to 10 kg bags, and private-label pouches or jars.

faqs.q: Can you support custom mesh sizes and private labeling?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide custom mesh specifications, OEM services, and private label packaging on request.

faqs.q: Are product samples available for industrial evaluation?
faqs.a: Yes, we supply product samples upon request to assist with commercial recipe development.

faqs.q: What is the shelf life and proper storage condition?
faqs.a: It has a shelf life of 18 to 24 months when stored in a cool, dry place.

faqs.q: Do you assist with international export documentation?
faqs.a: Yes, as an IEC-registered exporter, we provide full export documentation support for global shipments.
